fact: The Eswatini Revenue Service issued a request for proposals for a fiscalisation system using machine learning and AI for tax risk assessment and fraud detection, per Eswatini Financial Times.

Swazi24 reports that an AI-powered diabetic retinopathy diagnostic system, from the Taiwan Technical Mission's NCD Project, was launched and is operational at six public hospitals and health centres (Mbabane Government, Piggs Peak, Mankayane, RFM, Dvokolwako, Emkhuzweni), officiated by the Minister of Health.
